purpose: Unvalidated sector-ranking research with weekly/monthly/quarterly causal schedules and explicit portfolio accounting.

normalization.optional_older_history: extend backward only through contiguous complete snapshots

scoring.economic_signs: Preserved legacy assumptions; require domain review, not mechanically reversed.

ranked3.top_n_rule: Default3; N1 is100% per leg; N2..5 rank1 50%, remaining ranks50%/(N-1), worst short first.

timing.decision_cutoff: Friday, calendar month-end or quarter-end 23:59:59 America/New_York

accounting.turnover: sum(abs(target signed notional - current drifted signed notional))/pre-trade NAV
accounting.fees: one-way cost_bps/10000 times absolute traded notional on both legs
accounting.funding: extra long notional above pre-trade equity, fixed each rebalance, at available DFF ACT/365
accounting.funding_rate_cutoff: actual XNYS close at interval initial session, including early closes
accounting.short_borrow: prior-close marked short notional times annual borrow rate ACT/365
accounting.benchmark: frictionless SPY total return on identical dates
accounting.ruin: first daily close NAV<=0 terminates at zero; no restart

metrics.sharpe: mean(cycle net return - matching DFF cash return)/sample_std(excess)*sqrt(periods_per_year)
metrics.cash_reference: interval-compounded DFF ACT/365 using available prior-close rates
metrics.drawdown: daily marked NAV, with exact calendar-month sampled compatibility metric
metrics.annual_returns: calendar-year NAV returns from daily marks; initial/final incomplete years explicitly marked
metrics.rolling_excess: trailing calendar-year strategy return minus SPY return; previous available session at lookback date

research.robustness: ranked Top1/3/5 x weekly/monthly/quarterly; dates explicitly reported per grid cell
research.regimes: decision-time: stress if vol or credit>=0.5; else inflation if inflation>=0.5; else low_stress if both vol and credit<0; else balanced
research.rank_persistence: mean consecutive Spearman deterministic full ranks
research.holding_duration: mean observed signed-position spell days, boundary-censored
research.score_attribution: gross-normalized mean basket score points, not causal realized PnL
research.realized_attribution: sector dollar PnL / initial NAV; less actual costs reconciles total return before insolvency cap
research.chart_publication: 400-point extrema-preserving sampling; metrics use full daily marks
research.ranking_return_means: arithmetic top, bottom and top-minus-bottom unlevered total returns over complete selected-frequency cycles; excludes incomplete terminal cycles
